<thought>Based on the mass (C₅H₈O₂), IR (broad OH ~3540 cm⁻¹ and carbonyl ~1712 cm⁻¹), and the ¹H NMR pattern (3 H dd at 2.93 ppm, 1 H dd at 4.43 ppm, 2 H dd at 5.04 ppm, 1 H ddd at 6.05 ppm), the molecule is best described as an unsaturated carboxylic acid with a terminal alkene (CH₂=CH‑) and an allylic methyl group. The SMILES that fits this description is **C=CC(C)C(=O)O**, which corresponds to 3‑methyl‑2‑butenoic acid (isopentenoic acid). This structure reproduces the observed NMR splitting and chemical‑shift pattern and matches the IR functional‑group absorptions.</thought>
<final_answer>C=CC(C)C(=O)O</final_answer>
